name: 03054 · Merrimack, NH
findings: ZIP 03054 (Merrimack) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03054 (Merrimack) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 03054 (Merrimack) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
